name: Qwen-Audio-3.1-Realtime-Flash
access: QwenCloud realtime API (WebSocket; AOQ and WebRTC also listed); Singapore and China North 2 (Beijing) regions, each with an API key of that region; the examples use the Singapore endpoint [qwencloud-audio-guide] [qwencloud-page-audio31flash]

voice.output_audio: PCM 16-bit mono at 24 kHz; session.speech_rate 0.5 to 2.0 (default 1.0) [qwencloud-audio-guide] [qwencloud-audio-events]
voice.voices: Default longanqian_v3.1, plus the union of the qwen-audio-3.1-tts-plus and qwen-audio-3.1-tts-flash system voice lists, and cloned voices made with target_model set to this model (voice cloning for the realtime models is offered only in China North 2 (Beijing)); the voice can be set only in the first session.update [qwencloud-audio-guide] [qwencloud-audio-events] [qwencloud-voice-cloning]
languages: Conversation: German, English, Spanish, French, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Chinese, Thai, Vietnamese and Arabic, with 21 Chinese varieties [qwencloud-audio-guide]

session.input_audio_transcription.language sets the source language and session.output_audio.language the target language of the speech (a best effort, not a guarantee; the text language does not change) [qwencloud-audio-events]
voice.turn_detection: server_vad (default; threshold -1.0 to 1.0, default 0.5; silence_duration_ms 200 to 6000, default 800, 400 to 800 advised), smart_turn, smart_turn_v2 (recommended; better at bystanders and unrelated interjections), or null for push-to-talk; the mode can be set only before the first audio is sent [qwencloud-audio-events] [qwencloud-audio-ws]
voice.interruption: In server_vad and smart_turn modes new user speech cancels the running response; the client should clear its playback buffer on input_audio_buffer.speech_started; in the smart_turn modes fillers such as uh or hmm neither start a turn nor interrupt playback; speaker enhancement takes up to 5 reference recordings [qwencloud-audio-guide] [qwencloud-audio-events]
voice.session_limit: Not stated for this API; the model keeps at most 50 audio turns or 300 seconds of audio (max_history_turns 1 to 50, default 20) [qwencloud-audio-guide] [qwencloud-audio-events]

pricing_usd_per_mtok.notes: QwenCloud model page, per million tokens: audio input US$0.93 (the input field); text input US$0.23; text output US$0.7; text and audio output US$1.87 (the output field; output text is then not charged). The same rates as the 3.0 Flash page read on 2026-10-03. Rate limit 100,000 tokens and 60 requests per minute [qwencloud-page-audio31flash]

sources.quote: qwen-audio-3.1-realtime-flash supports enabling tools and enable_search together.
